outputs.explanation: The spatial expression panels are heatmap-style overlays (log2 expression intensity per spatial spot) on tissue images, not mean-based bar charts; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope/immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing median with 95% CI; every individual patient tumor value (n=512 LUAD, n=500 LUSC) is plotted as a dot, so individual data points are already shown.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean ± SD, but individual replicate values (n=3 dots per group) are overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement to show individual data points.
